verdict.rationale: The Honeycomb API is documented to programmatically manage queries, triggers, and SLOs, with a downloadable OpenAPI spec, so alerts can be defined and provisioned through the API. Board (dashboard) management via API is not named explicitly, being covered only by "and more". There is no evidence of a Terraform provider or an exportable JSON dashboard model. Missing for 10: explicit Boards/dashboards API or JSON definitions, Terraform provider, documented repeatable provisioning workflow, independent corroboration.
